structure.unit: Commercial Code — Warehouse Receipts, Bills of Lading and Other Documents of Title
Warehouse Receipts and Bills of Lading: Negotiation and Transfer

law.catch_line: Receipt or bill; when adequate compliance with commercial contract
law.text: Whether a document is adequate to fulfill the obligations of a contract for sale, a contract for lease, or the conditions of a letter of credit is governed by the titles on sales (Title 8.2), leases (Title 8.2A), or letters of credit (Title 8.5A).
